projects.name: 920 MW long-term nuclear power purchase agreements
projects.quote: We have signed an additional 920 megawatts (MW) of long-term power purchase agreements (PPA) for clean, reliable nuclear generation with a diverse set of investment grade customers.

projects.name: Walmart 176 MW power purchase agreement
projects.quote: Among these PPAs, our 176 MW agreement with Walmart will enable a 30 MW capacity expansion at our Dresden Clean Energy Center in Illinois and facilitate additional investments to strengthen the local community by supporting jobs and enabling continued expansion of operations and workforce.
